title: Do Public Goods Actually Reduce Inequality?
title_zh: 公共物品真的能减少不平等吗？
title_primary: 公共物品真的能减少不平等吗？
title_secondary: Do Public Goods Actually Reduce Inequality?
authors: Castanheira, Micael, Mariani, Giovanni Paolo, Tricaud, Clemence
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Public goods are meant to be universal, but they are inherently place-based. This paper systematically measures spatial access to public goods and quantifies the implications of distance to public facilities for income inequality. First, we map all schools and hospitals across Belgium. We compute the distance to facilities for each of the 20, 000 neighborhoods and document large spatial inequalities in access to public facilities. Second, we find that this unequal distribution favors high-income neighborhoods: allocating public goods spending proportionally to our access index increases income inequality compared to measures based solely on disposable income. Third, we show that the positive relationship between income and access can be rationalized by a simple model of public goods allocation with an inequality-neutral social planner. Finally, we provide evidence that access is strongly correlated with educational and health outcomes, emphasizing the need to consider the place-based nature of public goods when measuring inequality.
abstract_zh: 公共物品本应具有普遍性，但其本质上却具有地域性。本文系统衡量了公共物品的空间可达性，并量化了距离公共设施远近对收入不平等的影响。首先，我们绘制了比利时所有学校和医院的地图，计算了2万个社区中每个社区到设施的距离，并记录了公共设施可达性方面的巨大空间不平等。其次，我们发现这种不平等分布有利于高收入社区：与仅基于可支配收入的衡量标准相比，按我们的可达性指数比例分配公共物品支出会增加收入不平等。第三，我们证明收入与可达性之间的正相关关系可以通过一个具有不平等中立社会规划者的简单公共物品分配模型来合理化。最后，我们提供的证据表明，可达性与教育和健康结果密切相关，强调在衡量不平等时需要考虑公共物品的地域性特征。

title: Africa's Domestic Debt Boom: Evidence from the African Debt Database
title_zh: 非洲国内债务激增：来自非洲债务数据库的证据
title_primary: 非洲国内债务激增：来自非洲债务数据库的证据
title_secondary: Africa's Domestic Debt Boom: Evidence from the African Debt Database
authors: Manger, Mark, Mihalyi, David, Panizza, Ugo, NiccolÃ², Rescia,, Trebesch, Christoph 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper introduces the African Debt Database (ADD) - a new, comprehensive dataset that traces both domestic and external debt instruments at a granular level. The main innovation is a detailed mapping of Africa's domestic debt markets, drawing on rich, new data extracted from government auction reports and bond prospectuses. The database covers over 50,000 individual government loans and securities issued by 54 African countries between 2000 and 2024, amounting to a total of USD 6.3 trillion in debt. For each instrument, it provides harmonized micro-level information on currency, maturity, interest rates, instrument type, and creditor. The data reveal the growing dominance of domestic debt in Africa - albeit with substantial cross-country variation. Four stylized facts stand out: (i) the rapid expansion of domestic debt markets, especially in middle-income countries; (ii) the wide dispersion in borrowing costs and real interest rates; (iii) large cross-country differences in maturity structures and associated rollover risks; and (iv) a rising debt-service burden, particularly due to international bonds. Generally, this project shows that debt transparency is both feasible and valuable, even in data-scarce environments.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了非洲债务数据库（ADD）——一个全新的、全面的数据集，该数据集以微观层面追踪了国内外债务工具。其主要创新在于，基于从政府拍卖报告和债券募集说明书中提取的丰富新数据，对非洲国内债务市场进行了详细映射。该数据库涵盖了2000年至2024年间54个非洲国家发行的超过5万笔政府贷款和证券，债务总额达6.3万亿美元。针对每项工具，它提供了关于货币、期限、利率、工具类型和债权人的统一微观层面信息。数据显示，非洲国内债务的主导地位日益增强——尽管各国之间存在显著差异。四个典型事实尤为突出：（i）国内债务市场快速扩张，尤其是在中等收入国家；（ii）借贷成本和实际利率存在广泛差异；（iii）期限结构及相关展期风险存在巨大的跨国差异；以及（iv）偿债负担不断上升，尤其是国际债券带来的负担。总体而言，本项目表明，即使在数据稀缺的环境中，债务透明度既可行又具有重要价值。

title: Technology adoption and labour shortages: Evidence from Britain’s Industrial Revolution
title_zh: 技术采纳与劳动力短缺：来自英国工业革命的证据
title_primary: 技术采纳与劳动力短缺：来自英国工业革命的证据
title_secondary: Technology adoption and labour shortages: Evidence from Britain’s Industrial Revolution
authors: Bruno Caprettini, Alex Trew, Hans-Joachim Voth
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As populations in rich countries age and fewer youngsters enter the labour force, employers and politicians bemoan labour ‘shortages’. This column turns to historical evidence to highlight why governments should learn to love labour shortages. Between 1792 and 1815, as Britain and France fought each other for global dominance, more than one out of every ten British men ended up in the army or navy, resulting in acute labour shortages and upward pressure on wages. The authors show how this labour scarcity and a skill abundance complemented each other in driving technology diffusion, boosting British productivity in the long run.
abstract_zh: 随着富裕国家人口老龄化及年轻劳动力减少，雇主和政界人士纷纷抱怨劳动力"短缺"。本文通过历史证据揭示政府为何应学会拥抱劳动力短缺。1792年至1815年间，当英法为争夺全球霸权而战时，超过十分之一的英国男性最终服役于陆军或海军，导致严重劳动力短缺并推高工资水平。作者论证了这种劳动力稀缺与技能充裕如何相互促进，推动技术扩散，最终在长期内提升了英国的生产率。

title: Sovereign Default and the Decline in Interest Rates*
title_zh: 主权违约与利率下降
title_primary: 主权违约与利率下降
title_secondary: Sovereign Default and the Decline in Interest Rates*
authors: Max Miller, James D Paron, Jessica A Wachter
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Sovereign debt yields have undergone a historic decline over the last half century. Standard explanations, including aging populations and increases in asset demand from abroad, encounter difficulties when confronted with the full range of evidence. We propose an explanation based on a decline in inflation and default risk. We show that a model with sovereign default captures the decline in interest rates, the stability of equity valuation ratios, and the reduction in investment and output growth. Calibrations of the model post-COVID suggest that sovereign default risk may have returned.
abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪，主权债务收益率经历了历史性下降。标准解释（包括人口老龄化及国外资产需求增加）在面临全面证据时遭遇困难。我们提出基于通胀与违约风险下降的解释。研究表明，包含主权违约的模型能够捕捉利率下降、股权估值比率稳定以及投资与产出增长放缓的特征。新冠疫情后的模型校准表明，主权违约风险可能已经重现。

title: Fiscal Policy in Small Open Economies: The International Intertemporal Keynesian Cross
title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的财政政策：国际跨期凯恩斯交叉
title_primary: 小型开放经济体中的财政政策：国际跨期凯恩斯交叉
title_secondary: Fiscal Policy in Small Open Economies: The International Intertemporal Keynesian Cross
authors: Jacob Sundram
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A recent literature studies fiscal policy with realistic intertemporal marginal propensities to consume and the absence of Ricardian equivalence. This literature shows that fiscal policy boosts consumption and is effective: (i) Cumulative fiscal multipliers are above one, and (ii) fiscal policy is fully self-financing. I show this does not extend to small open economies by providing conditions where (i) the cumulative fiscal multiplier is exactly one, and (ii) fiscal deficits are not fully self-financing. This is because the initial debt-fueled rise in consumption is offset by a drop to repay foreign debt. Finally, I provide conditions to overturn this result.
abstract_zh: 近期文献在考虑现实跨期边际消费倾向且不存在李嘉图等价的前提下，研究了财政政策效应。该文献表明，财政政策能够促进消费且具有有效性：（i）累积财政乘数大于1，（ii）财政政策可实现完全自我融资。本文通过设定条件证明，这一结论并不适用于小型开放经济体：在这些条件下，（i）累积财政乘数恰好等于1，（ii）财政赤字无法实现完全自我融资。其根本原因在于，由债务驱动的初始消费增长将被偿还外债所导致的消费下降所抵消。最后，本文提出了可推翻该结论的条件。

title: Supply Shocks in a Heterogeneous-Firm New Keynesian Model: The Entry Multiplier
title_zh: 异质性企业新凯恩斯模型中的供给冲击：进入乘数
title_primary: 异质性企业新凯恩斯模型中的供给冲击：进入乘数
title_secondary: Supply Shocks in a Heterogeneous-Firm New Keynesian Model: The Entry Multiplier
authors: Florin Bilbiie, Marc J Melitz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study productivity shocks in a New Keynesian model with endogenous entry, selection, and nominal rigidities. Adjustment along the extensive margin fundamentally alters the transmission of TFP shocks. Under sticky prices, productivity disturbances generate a large “entry multiplier”: firm entry-exit responds much more strongly than under flexible prices, even when output is allocatively efficient to first order. Introducing wage stickiness breaks this neutrality. Adverse TFP shocks reduce profits, trigger exit, and generate a negative output gap while remaining inflationary. Productivity shocks therefore behave as true supply shocks, without resorting to ad hoc cost-push or markup disturbances. Unlike standard markup shocks, TFP shocks in our framework imply procyclical profits and entry, consistent with the data. When wages are sufficiently sticky, expansionary monetary policy raises entry, closes the negative output gap, and improves welfare. The model remains analytically tractable and isomorphic to the standard New Keynesian framework, with entry and selection appearing as simple wedges.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含内生进入、选择效应和名义刚性的新凯恩斯模型中的生产率冲击。沿扩展边际的调整从根本上改变了全要素生产率冲击的传导机制。在价格粘性条件下，生产率扰动会产生巨大的"进入乘数"效应：即使产出在一阶条件下达到配置效率，企业进入与退出对生产率冲击的反应仍远强于灵活价格情形。引入工资粘性会打破这种中性效应。不利的全要素生产率冲击会降低利润、引发企业退出，并在保持通胀压力的同时产生负向产出缺口。因此，生产率冲击无需借助特设的成本推动或加成率扰动，即可表现为真正的供给冲击。与标准加成率冲击不同，我们框架中的全要素生产率冲击意味着顺周期的利润与进入行为，这与数据特征一致。当工资粘性足够强时，扩张性货币政策能够促进企业进入、缩小负向产出缺口并提升社会福利。该模型保持解析可处理性，且与标准新凯恩斯框架同构，其中进入与选择效应以简单楔子形式呈现。

title: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
title_zh: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类
title_primary: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类
title_secondary: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
authors: Alp Atakan, Michael Richter, Matan Tsur
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中异质性主体首先做出投资决策，随后进行有成本的搜索以形成生产性匹配。交易过程是一个带有明确搜索成本的随机搜索与讨价还价过程。尽管存在潜在的敲竹杠和匹配问题，我们证明了约束有效配置是一个均衡：主体在投资以及搜索过程中接受或拒绝潜在合作伙伴的私人激励与社会福利完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的分类结果，证明了均衡的存在性，并给出了唯一性的条件。

title: Political violence in African borderlands
title_zh: 非洲边境地区的政治暴力
title_primary: 非洲边境地区的政治暴力
title_secondary: Political violence in African borderlands
authors: Russell, David, Walther, Olivier J., Trémolières, Marie
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between borderlands and political violence in Africa. Do African conflicts relocate or expand across borders? Using spatiotemporal data on conflict events from 1997 to 2024 alongside the innovative OECD/SWAC Spatial Conflict Dynamics indicator (SCDi), the paper suggests that borderlands experience more conflict than non-borderlands. Approximately half of all violent events occur within 100 km of a border. In Africa, political violence also tends to decrease very rapidly with distance from borders. The proportion of violent events recorded in borderlands varies over time and mirrors the cycles of violence that affect specific regions. This share was very high in the early 2000s due to the wars in the Gulf of Guinea and the Great Lakes region. It then declined for less than a decade before increasing substantially in the 2010s. Finally, the paper demonstrates that when conflicts diffuse across borders, they tend to occupy a greater spatial extent rather than simply moving from one side of the border to the other. These findings suggest that more policy efforts should be devoted to monitor the circulation of armed groups across West African borders.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非洲边境地区与政治暴力之间的关系。非洲冲突是否会跨境转移或扩散？利用1997年至2024年冲突事件的时空数据，并结合创新的OECD/SWAC空间冲突动态指标（SCDi），本文发现边境地区比非边境地区经历更多冲突。约半数暴力事件发生在距边境100公里范围内。在非洲，政治暴力随距边境距离增加而急剧减少。边境地区记录的暴力事件比例随时间变化，并反映了影响特定区域的暴力周期。由于几内亚湾和大湖地区的战争，这一比例在21世纪初非常高；随后下降不到十年，在2010年代又大幅上升。最后，本文证明，当冲突跨境扩散时，它们往往占据更大的空间范围，而非简单地从边境一侧转移到另一侧。这些发现表明，应投入更多政策努力来监测西非边境地区武装团体的流动。

title: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh
title_zh: 正式化争端解决：孟加拉国村级法庭的影响
title_primary: 正式化争端解决：孟加拉国村级法庭的影响
title_secondary: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh
authors: Martin Mattsson, Ahmed Mushfiq Mobarak
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Dispute resolution in low-income countries is typically done by either a costly and slow formal court or an informal institution without state-sanctioned enforcement powers. Can access to justice be increased by combining the best aspects of formal and informal institutions? We evaluate the effects of “Village Courts” (VCs) in rural Bangladesh using a large-scale field experiment. The introduction of VCs more than doubles the share of disputes resolved in state-sanctioned courts, but an informal institution called shalish remains dominant. There is some substitution from shalish to VCs, but congestion in higher-level courts, village social dynamics, and economic activity remain unaffected.
abstract_zh: 低收入国家的纠纷解决通常依赖于成本高昂且效率低下的正式法院，或缺乏国家强制执行力保障的非正式机构。能否通过融合正式与非正式机构的优势来提升司法可及性？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，评估了孟加拉国农村地区"村级法院"（VCs）的实施效果。村级法院的引入使经国家认可法院解决的纠纷比例提升了一倍以上，但名为"沙利什"的非正式机构仍占据主导地位。尽管存在从沙利什向村级法院的部分替代效应，但上级法院的案件积压、村庄社会动态及经济活动均未受到显著影响。

title: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
title_zh: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据
title_primary: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据
title_secondary: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
authors: Sébastien Houde
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A coarse certification provides simple but incomplete information. Its rationale is to help consumers trade off dimensions of quality that are complex and lack salience. In imperfectly competitive markets, it may induce excess bunching at the certification requirement, crowd out quality, and facilitate price discrimination. Who will ultimately benefit from a coarse certification thus depends on the degree of market power firms can exercise as well as on consumers' sophistication in responding to such information. I use a structural econometric model of the U.S. appliance market to illustrate these insights using the ENERGY STAR certification as a case study.
abstract_zh: 粗放型认证提供简单但不完整的信息。其基本原理是帮助消费者权衡复杂且缺乏显著性的质量维度。在不完全竞争市场中，这种认证可能导致企业在认证要求处过度聚集、挤占质量提升空间，并促进价格歧视。因此，粗放型认证的最终受益者取决于企业能够行使的市场势力程度，以及消费者对此类信息的反应成熟度。本文以能源之星认证为案例，运用美国家电市场的结构计量经济学模型来阐释上述见解。

title: Green Investing and Political Behavior
title_zh: 绿色投资与政治行为
title_primary: 绿色投资与政治行为
title_secondary: Green Investing and Political Behavior
authors: Florian Heeb, Julian F Kölbel, Stefano Ramelli, Anna Vasileva
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies. (JEL D14, H42, G18, P16)
abstract_zh: 关于绿色投资的一个核心担忧是，它可能会挤占公众对解决负外部性问题的公共政策的政治支持。我们在瑞士一项气候法案全民公投前夕开展了一项预注册实验，对此进行了检验。研究发现，提供投资气候友好型基金的机会，并不会降低个人对气候监管的支持（以政治捐款和投票意向衡量）。在英国重复该实验后得到了类似结果。我们的估计结果否定了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持存在适度的挤入效应。（JEL D14, H42, G18, P16）

title: The impact of inflation on incremental costs in HTA
title_zh: 通货膨胀对卫生技术评估中增量成本的影响
title_primary: 通货膨胀对卫生技术评估中增量成本的影响
title_secondary: The impact of inflation on incremental costs in HTA
authors: Sam Large, Joe Trim, Ella Barker, Louis Zanden, Phill O’Neill 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Inflation reshapes the economic landscape in which new treatments are evaluated. Yet cost-effectiveness thresholds tend to remain fixed over time. This report examines how inflation in NHS healthcare costs associated with resource use affects the estimation of incremental costs in health technology assessment (HTA), and what this means for the cost‑effectiveness and commercial viability of new technologies when decision thresholds do not adjust accordingly. Throughout this paper, we distinguish between intervention costs (e.g. the price of treatments) and background NHS costs (i.e. healthcare resource use associated with delivering care related or unrelated to an intervention). authors: Stavros Degiannakis, George Filis, Grigorios Siourounis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We assess the impact of cryptocurrencies ultra-high frequency trading on financial stability. Focusing on three well-established cryptocurrencies, namely Bitcoin, Ethereum and Sui, we show that as the trading frequency increases, so do the excess potential losses of the investors, over and above the anticipated losses based on the Value-at-Risk. This is led by the exponential growth of the kurtosis that is exhibited at high-frequency trading. Given that currently the minimum capital requirements do not differentiate between the trading frequency but only between the type of cryptoassets groups, we show that such overlook poses a threat to the financial stability.

title: The role of social norms in zero price effects
title_zh: 社会规范在零价格效应中的作用
title_primary: 社会规范在零价格效应中的作用
title_secondary: The role of social norms in zero price effects
authors: Zhang, Xian, Lane, Tom, Grisolía 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A zero price effect is a discontinuous change in demand when price is reduced to zero from a level arbitrarily close to it. It has been proposed that social norms play a role in zero price effects on consumption. We first conducted a norm-elicitation experiment to measure how people perceive the social appropriateness of consumption under zero versus minimal prices. We then ran a natural field experiment in the same contexts to observe actual taking behavior. Results show that the social appropriateness of consuming high quantities is significantly lower when goods are offered for free than when they are sold at 1 cent. Zero pricing increases the proportion of individuals who consume something, but reduces the average amount taken by those who consume positive amounts. Overall, the evidence suggests that high consumption of free goods is prevented by its social inappropriateness, potentially helping to explain the inconsistent evidence on the direction of zero price effects in previous studies.
abstract_zh: 零价格效应是指当价格从任意接近零的水平降至零时，需求发生的不连续变化。已有研究提出，社会规范在零价格对消费的影响中发挥作用。我们首先开展了一项规范诱导实验，以衡量人们在零价格与最低价格条件下对消费社会适当性的认知。随后，我们在相同情境下进行了一项自然田野实验，以观察实际获取行为。结果表明，当商品免费提供时，大量消费的社会适当性显著低于以1美分出售的情况。零价格增加了消费某种物品的个体比例，但降低了消费正数量个体的平均获取量。总体而言，证据表明免费商品的高消费因其社会不适当性而受到抑制，这或许有助于解释以往研究中关于零价格效应方向的不一致证据。

title_secondary: Reallocation Effects of Internalizing Externalities: Evidence From China's Straw Burning Ban
authors: Wenyuan Hua
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the reallocation effects of a typical environmental policy aiming to internalize externalities: the straw burning ban across China. The ban prohibited the traditional farming practice of burning straw while compelling the labour‐intensive practice of straw utilization. We show that the legislation banning straw burning led to an increase in local land renting activities. Our results indicate that implementation of the ban resulted in a within‐village land redistribution, encouraging the exit of less‐productive farmers while promoting land expansion by more‐productive farmers. Consequently, village‐level aggregate agricultural output and productivity increased by 5% and 3%, respectively. A complementary policy instrument to the command‐and‐control ban—establishing biomass power plants to incentivize farmers to collect crop residues—led to a greater land redistribution in villages with a nearby biomass power plant after the ban is imposed, relative to before.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了一项旨在内化外部性的典型环境政策——中国秸秆禁烧令——的重新配置效应。该禁令禁止了传统的秸秆焚烧耕作方式，同时强制推行劳动密集型的秸秆利用实践。我们证明，秸秆禁烧立法导致当地土地租赁活动增加。研究结果表明，禁令的实施引发了村内土地重新分配，促使低生产率农户退出，同时推动高生产率农户扩大土地规模。由此，村级农业总产出和生产率分别提升了5%和3%。作为命令控制型禁令的补充政策工具——建立生物质发电厂以激励农户收集农作物残余物——在禁令实施后，相较于实施前，导致邻近生物质发电厂的村庄出现了更显著的土地重新分配。

title_secondary: Ignorance is Whose Bliss: The Repeal of Compulsory Premarital Health Examinations and Marital Outcomes in Rural China
authors: Li Han, Xinzheng Shi, Ming-ang Zhang
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Health matters for marital outcomes, but health information may remain concealed until marriage. Our matching model, which incorporates socioeconomic status (SES) and health, predicts that the removal of health information should shift sorting toward SES, potentially reducing child health and welfare, particularly for those with low SES. We empirically examine this in the context of rural China, following the repeal of compulsory premarital health examinations (PHE). Our difference-in-differences estimation, which compares provinces with varying levels of exposure based on pre-policy PHE rates, confirms a larger shift in sorting patterns in provinces with higher treatment intensity. The decrease in health-based assortative matching negatively affects child health outcomes, which is followed by a decline in postmarital subjective well-being. Women and low-SES individuals experience larger losses than their counterparts within the same highly affected provinces, highlighting persistent gender and socioeconomic disparities.
abstract_zh: 健康对婚姻结果至关重要，但健康信息可能在婚前仍处于隐匿状态。我们的匹配模型纳入了社会经济地位（SES）与健康因素，预测健康信息的消除将促使婚配模式转向以SES为基础，这可能降低儿童健康与福利水平，尤其对低SES群体影响显著。我们以中国农村地区为背景，在强制婚前健康检查（PHE）制度取消后展开实证研究。基于政策实施前各省PHE覆盖率差异，采用双重差分法比较不同暴露程度的省份，证实治疗强度较高的省份婚配模式转变幅度更大。基于健康指标的选型匹配减少对儿童健康结果产生负面影响，进而导致婚后主观幸福感下降。在同一高影响省份内，女性和低SES群体相比其他群体遭受更大损失，凸显了持续存在的性别与社会经济不平等。

title: Lost ground, lost value: Investigating the relationship between soil erosion and agricultural land value
title_zh: 土地流失，价值损失：探究土壤侵蚀与农地价值之间的关系
title_primary: 土地流失，价值损失：探究土壤侵蚀与农地价值之间的关系
title_secondary: Lost ground, lost value: Investigating the relationship between soil erosion and agricultural land value
authors: Le Chen, Roderick M. Rejesus, Hongqiang Yan, Serkan Aglasan
official: 官方在线 2026-01-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the impact of soil erosion on agricultural land values in the United States (US) Midwest. Based on a novel county‐level panel data set with information on soil erosion levels and agricultural land values covering five census years (1997, 2002, 2007, 2012, and 2017), we separately investigate the direct effect of two types of soil erosion—water and wind erosion—on county‐level average agricultural land values. Linear panel fixed effects econometric models and a number of robustness checks are used to achieve the study objective. We find that increasing soil erosion levels have a statistically significant negative impact on agricultural land values at the county level. Our findings confirm that damages to the soil from water or wind erosion are capitalized into lower farmland values. The study provides new insights in terms of further understanding the economic damages due to soil erosion and the likely benefits from soil erosion control.

abstract: In hedonic studies of how environmental disamenities influence house prices, the homes that are treated are typically unknown. We propose a new method for defining treatment buffers and apply our technique to disamenities that have thus far received little attention: surface coal mines. Our leave-one-out cross-validation approach identifies an optimal buffer of 2,300 m in two Appalachian counties at which effects dissipate. Hedonic regressions indicate that treated homes sell for 15.5% less than untreated homes. We supplement these results with nearest-neighbor covariate matching models and recover average treatment effects on the treated of 14.7% price reductions. JEL Q32C21
